response.justification: Despite extensive senior-level experience, the candidate lacks junior-level alignment: Java is listed among skills but not used in recent roles, German proficiency is only basic (required fluent), and the resume reflects a senior/lead profile with no indication of willingness or readiness to start as an entry-level contributor in an insurance-sector agile team.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and domains
Strong open-source contributions and technical teaching background
Demonstrated proficiency in agile practices and CI/CD pipelines
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not meeting fluency requirement
Recent work is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js/DLang, not Java or insurance domain
Overqualified for junior role with 10+ years of senior experience
